prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA and ETS tie for trend champion (corr=1.0), but ARIMA selected as it appears first. FT_rf dominates seasonality capture (corr=0.5664) while ONLY_CWT_rf achieves lowest overall RMSE (110.01). High model disagreement (spread ratio 32.76) and divergent early/late horizon specialists (ONLY_CWT_catboost vs ONLY_CWT_rf) suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance.
